title: 6 Days Thrilling Offbeat Tour to Sri Lanka with Dambulla
highlights: Soak in Sri Lanka's diverse charm, from its stunning landscapes and rich history to vibrant cultural experiences and timeless heritage sites.
Marvel at the stunning Bahiravokanda Vihara Buddha Statue, a towering symbol of peace, offering stunning views of Kandy's lush surroundings.
Ascend the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and marvel at its ancient architecture, royal gardens, and panoramic views.
Witness the amazing architecture of Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple, a serene blend of traditional and modern designs that showcases Sri Lanka's spiritual essence.
Visit the revered Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, home to Buddha's sacred tooth, and soak in its spiritual ambiance.
overview:
About the Tour:
With its lush tea plantations & waterfalls, tropical beaches, jaw-dropping wildlife, historical monuments & temples Sri Lanka, an island escape awaiting for you. From ultra modern amenities, towering skyscrapers, shopping complexes, to a rocking nightlife, Colombo is the temple of all spoilt luxury.
Enroute Dambulla, stop by and pay a visit to the home of abandoned Sri Lankan Elephants - The Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and watch the naughty elephants, yet adorable creatures bathe in the river near the orphanage where they engage in mischief, pull each other by their tails, and try to escape the hands of their caretakers in amusing ways. Prepare yourself for a little challenge and conquer the 1200+ steps marked with good paths and stairs to reach the top of the Sigiriya Lion Rock. Capture glimpses of the incredible 360 degrees view over the whole area from above where every corner has its own unique view. Moving ahead, peek into some of the tea estates and welcome the fresh aroma of the tea and herbs in the rolling green hills offering breathtaking views in Nuwara Eliya. Conclude this tour by visiting the Red Mosque, a stunning candy-like red and white striped mosque named ‘Jami Ul-Alfar’ is the most spectacular building in your entire trip in Colombo.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Colombo | En route visit to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage | Transfer to Dambulla
days.desc: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Upon your arrival at the airport, board your transfer and enjoy a scenic drive to Dambulla, a cultural gem in the heart of the island. En route, make a stop and visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, a sanctuary dedicated to the care of orphaned and injured elephants. Also, get a rare glimpse into their daily lives of being fed and bathed. After an amazing visit, continue your journey to Dambulla. Upon reaching your hotel, check in and enjoy your overnight stay.

days.title: Excursion to Sigiriya
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of Sri Lanka's iconic landmarks. Once there, climb the stone-carved staircase, passing the intricately painted frescoes and the impressive Lion’s Gate, a testament to the site’s regal past. From the top, marvel at the panoramic views of lush forests and villages. Also, explore the royal gardens and marvel at the intricate stone carvings. Later, get driven back to your hotel in Dambulla.

days.title: Transfer to Nuwara Eliya | En Route Kandy Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to Nuwara Eliya. En route, explore Kandy on a sightseeing tour and visit the towering Bahirawakanda Vihara Buddha Statue, offering panoramic views of Kandy. Next, visit the Peradeniya Botanical Gardens & witness its stunning collection of over 4,000 plant species. Also, wander through the iconic Royal Palm Avenue & visit the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, one of Buddhism’s most significant sites. Then, continue your journey, & upon arrival, check-in to your hotel.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic

days.title: Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, explore Nuwara Eliya on a sightseeing tour. Begin with a visit to the Hanuman Temple, a sanctuary steeped in Ramayana mythology, & soak in its calming atmosphere. Next, marvel at the breathtaking Ramboda Falls and admire the intricate architecture of Seetha Amman Kovil, a sacred temple associated with the epic tale of Ramayana. Also, stroll through the Hakgala Botanical Gardens & Victoria Park, home to diverse flora. Conclude your day at the Gregory Lake, where you can opt for boating.

items.title: Full Day Nuwara Eliya Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Transfer to Colombo | Colombo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: After check-out, get driven to Colombo, Sri Lanka’s bustling capital. Upon arrival, check-in to your hotel and realx. Later, explore the city on a sightseeing tour & visit the iconic Lotus Tower, a striking landmark that offers panoramic views of Colombo’s skyline. Next, marvel at the traditional and contemporary architecture of the Gangaramaya Buddhist Temple. Continue to the Pettah Floating Market to witness its stunning floating stalls and explore more of Colombo’s attractions.

items.title: Full Day Colombo Sightseeing Tour on a Private basis

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, get ready and check-out from your hotel. Then, board your transfer to Colombo Airport. Once there, board your flight back home, this marks the end of your amazing Sri Lanka trip!
